summary: Iter58 (Bulk Trip Actions P1, Auth IP-Burst Alerts P2, Sparkline Hour-Slice Drill P3) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite = 13/13 PASS. All frontend flows verified live. No regressions in Trip Log, Dashboard, Deploy Guard, or Auth drill-down. auth_ip_burst alert row inspected — fully PII-safe (no authorization/cookie/token/password/bearer). Sparkline bucket click opens drill-down with hour-slice scope; AUTH counter click restores 'Last 24h'.
critical_code_review_comments: PII SAFETY: auth_ip_burst alert row inspected via /api/admin/save-health/alerts — contains only {kind, fired_at, ip, count, threshold, window_minutes, first_seen, last_seen, sample_paths, acknowledged, email_delivery}. No occurrence of authorization/cookie/token/password/bearer/session_token/auth_header. ✅

Bulk-invoice creates a REAL invoice via POST /api/invoices (id starts with 'inv', trip_ids populated, trips flip to status='invoiced' with invoice_id linked). Not a flag-only shortcut — matches user's explicit requirement.
Bulk-delete of invoiced trips correctly requires force_invoiced=True and recomputes affected invoice (recomputed_invoices returned in response).
Export company scoping preserved even with explicit trip_ids — cross-company request returns empty (header-only, no data rows).
Regression Guard endpoint /api/auth/health reports status=pass, exit_code=0, strict_mode=true. Full backend suite green.
